notes: Sheet title written on the sketch: FIRST FLOOR PLAN.
"ROAD" is written along the bottom (south) edge of the sheet.
"OP-2" is written against the opening in the wall between DRESS and MASTER BED ROOM 1.

Stair treads are numbered on the sketch: 24 and 32 at the ends of the north flight, 33 / 34 / 35 at the turn, 36 and 44 at the ends of the south flight. Two small red down-arrows are drawn beside 33-34-35.
"UP" with an arrow pointing east sits at the west end of the north flight; "DN" sits at the west end of the south flight.
assumptions: No compass or north arrow is drawn anywhere on the sketch. "ROAD" is written along the bottom edge. north_deg has been left at 90 (sheet north up); the true orientation is not shown.

No wall-thickness callout is written anywhere on the sketch. Thicknesses were measured against the 25' and 40' overall dimensions: the exterior walls, the spine wall, the O.T.S/TOILET south wall, the MASTER BED ROOM 2 south wall, the mid wall and the MASTER BED ROOM 1 east wall all scale at about 9"; the TOILET/DRESS partitions and the O.T.S–TOILET partition scale at about 4½". These are measured, not written.

The written room dimensions add up to about 4½" more than the written overall 25' in both the north band (9'-10" + 14'-0" + walls) and the south band (14'-0" + 9'-10½" + walls). The plot has been held at the written 25' x 40' and the surplus absorbed on the east side, so every west-side written dimension comes out exact. As a result MASTER BED ROOM 2 is 13'-8" clear (written 14'-0"), the top-right TOILET is 7'-6" clear (written 7'-10½") and the bottom-right OPEN TERRACE is 9'-6" clear (written 9'-10½").

The west chain is internally consistent and was used to fix the spine wall: TOILET 6'-0" + 4½" partition + PASSAGE 3'-5½" = 9'-10", which is exactly the written width of OPEN TERRACE (top left). That is why the TOILET/DRESS east partition is taken as 4½" thick.

The O.T.S and the top-right TOILET are drawn sharing one continuous south wall, but their written depths differ (4'-1½" and 4'-6"). The wall has been kept on one line at the TOILET's 4'-6", so the O.T.S comes out 4'-6" deep instead of the written 4'-1½".

The LOBBY's written 7'-2½" depth is about 4½" more than the band actually left between the MASTER BED ROOM 2 south wall and the mid wall (6'-10"). The LOBBY zone has been drawn to its written size and therefore overlaps the mid wall centre-line slightly.

The 40' overall runs from the north face of the building to the south face of the planter parapet. The building's own south wall (MASTER BED ROOM 1 / OPEN TERRACE) sits at y = 2.125; the PLANTER strip south of it measures about 1'-4½" clear. The planter depth is measured, not written, and the PLANTER carries no written size on the sketch.

No door schedule or door widths are written. Widths were measured off the swing arcs: D1 and D3 scale at about 3'-0"; D4 (both toilet doors) at about 2'-6". D4 in the top-right TOILET is drawn hard against the east exterior wall, and D3 is drawn hard against the south exterior wall, so both are positioned hard against those walls rather than centred.

No window widths are written. W2, W3, W4, V1 and OP-2 were all measured against the 25' and 40' overall dimensions. W3 measures about 9'-5" wide in the south wall of MASTER BED ROOM 1 — unusually wide, but that is the extent of the window symbol that is drawn.

A door is drawn at the south end of the PASSAGE, in the same wall line as D1 into MASTER BED ROOM 2, swinging north into the PASSAGE. The sketch does not tag it, so it has been given tag "D". Its width (about 3'-0") and position were measured.
An untagged window symbol is drawn in the north wall of the west TOILET, opening onto OPEN TERRACE (top left). It has been given tag "W"; the sketch writes no mark on it.

The two rooms named "TOILET" and the two named "OPEN TERRACE" are kept exactly as written, with no suffix added. Every swing reference is unambiguous because only one room of that name touches the wall concerned: W-NORTH-BAND touches only the top-right TOILET, W-TOIL-S only the west TOILET, and W-MBR1-E only the bottom-right OPEN TERRACE.

No wall is drawn between the LOBBY and the staircase, so none is listed — the stair mouth is left fully open, as drawn. The "UP", "DN" and step-number tags occupy that strip on the sketch; there is no wall line there.

The PASSAGE has no wall across its north end. The wall under OPEN TERRACE (top left) stops at the TOILET/DRESS east partition, so the PASSAGE runs straight out into the terrace, and it is traced that way.

The staircase is read as a half-turn (U) stair: the north flight climbs west to east, steps 24 to 32 (9 treads); three turning steps 33, 34, 35 against the east exterior wall; then the south flight runs east to west, steps 36 to 44 (9 treads). Treads are drawn as vertical lines in both flights, so both flights run on the x axis. No landing is labelled and no square landing is dimensioned, so the turn is reported as three winders, not as the two landings of a U3. The well between the flights is drawn as a rectangle with an X.
The stair footprint was measured against the overall dimensions; no dimension is written on the stair itself, and no tread or riser size is given.

A small rectangle roughly 2'-0" x 1'-9" is drawn inside OPEN TERRACE (top left), against the north face of the west TOILET's wall near the west end. It carries no label and could not be identified, so it has not been included.
MASTER BED ROOM 2 shows no window in the east exterior wall on the sketch; its only window is W2 onto the O.T.S. Nothing else is drawn in that wall, so nothing has been added.

No "Railing", "Parapet" or "Handrail" is labelled anywhere on the sketch. Both OPEN TERRACE areas are enclosed by the drawn exterior walls, which are listed as ordinary walls, and no railing has been invented.

The image was read at full page size only; the environment would not allow the file to be cropped and enlarged, so all measured figures were scaled off the full-size view and carry the corresponding tolerance.
